I'll solve this problem from scratch by calculating 50! and summing its digits.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-RSI/ebd00391-ba98-5b98-9125-83abd1dce979/scratchpad && python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 50 factorial
factorial_50 = math.factorial(50)
print(f"50! = {factorial_50}")

# Convert to string to access individual digits
factorial_str = str(factorial_50)
print(f"Digits: {factorial_str}")
print(f"Number of digits: {len(factorial_str)}")

# Sum all the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in factorial_str)
print(f"\nSum of digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Perfect! Let me verify this calculation:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-RSI/ebd00391-ba98-5b98-9125-83abd1dce979/scratchpad && python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Double-check: calculate 50! and sum digits
n = math.factorial(50)
print(f"50! = {n}")

# Get individual digits and sum them
digits = [int(d) for d in str(n)]
print(f"Digits: {digits}")
print(f"Sum: {sum(digits)}")

# Verify by adding them manually
manual_sum = 0
for digit in str(n):
    manual_sum += int(digit)
print(f"Manual verification: {manual_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
